annotations.title: Get citation questions for a vertical

description: Returns the set of buying-intent questions Citehound uses to test whether an AI assistant names a brand, for one vertical, plus a short protocol a person can run in their own assistant: ask each question in a separate conversation three to five times, note whether the brand is named and whether it appears in a heading, list label, table or bold text, and judge the spread rather than one answer. The questions don’t name any brand in the category being measured. A few mention an integration platform such as Slack or Google Workspace, because that is how buyers ask. Read-only: it reads a content file and queries no model. There is deliberately no tool that runs the check for you: a run is about 90 model calls at about five seconds each, far past this server’s time limit, and it would spend a quota anyone could drain. Question sets exist for: consumerapps, crm, cybersecurity, devtools, ecommerce, fintech, health, hospitality, hrtech, legal, localservices, marketplaces, martech, realestate. Use when the user asks how to check whether an assistant names their brand, or wants the questions for their category.
